caseName: Krauss Brothers Lumber Co. v. Mellon
caseNameFull: Krauss Brothers Lumber Company v. Andrew W. Mellon, Director General
attorneys: Mr. Brenton K. Fisk for petitioner. Messrs. Sidney F. Andrews and Alexander M. Bull for respondents.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari granted, the discussion to be limited to the question of practice in respect to the bill of exceptions upon which the case in the Circuit Court of- Appeals was made to turn.
